name: useSpeechAI
summary: Turning speech into text, on the device or in the cloud.
plain: Records the user talking and returns what they said. It can use the phone's own on-device recogniser, or send a recorded clip to Gemini. On-device keeps audio on the phone and streams partial text; cloud handles harder audio and needs an API key.
description: In 'on-device' mode the native module drives Android's SpeechRecognizer with the on-device recogniser (API 31+, SpeechRecognizer.isOnDeviceRecognitionAvailable) and emits partial results as the user speaks; it never silently switches to the default or cloud recogniser, and fails with the reason in error when the on-device one is unavailable. In 'cloud' mode the clip is recorded through useAudio at 16 kHz mono on the voice_recognition source, which applies the platform noise suppression, and sent to Gemini audio understanding. Neither path fabricates a transcript: without a key, cloud mode keeps the recording and returns an error.

returns.name: isListening
returns.desc: True while the microphone is capturing.

returns.name: isTranscribing
returns.desc: True while audio is being converted to text.

returns.name: recognitionMode
returns.desc: Which engine will handle the next transcription.

returns.name: isOfflineAvailable
returns.desc: Whether the platform reports an on-device recogniser (SpeechRecognizer.isOnDeviceRecognitionAvailable, API 31+). It is not specific to a language: a language the recogniser lacks can still fail at start.

returns.name: streamingPartial
returns.desc: Live text as the user is still speaking, on-device mode only.

returns.name: voiceDecibels
returns.desc: Current input level, for a meter or a speaking indicator.

returns.name: lastTranscript
returns.desc: Final text with confidence, audio duration and latency.

returns.name: lastRecordingUri
returns.desc: File of the last capture, kept even when transcription fails.

returns.name: model
returns.desc: Engine used for the last cloud transcription.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: 'hardware' when the platform reports an on-device recogniser (isOfflineAvailable); 'unavailable' otherwise, including in cloud mode, where the transcript comes from Gemini and not from the device.

actions.name: startListening()
actions.desc: Opens the microphone using the current recognitionMode: the on-device recognizer, or a recording for cloud transcription.
actions.output: Resolves true when the microphone opened, false with the reason in error when permission was denied or the recognizer refused.

actions.name: stopListeningAndTranscribe()
actions.desc: Closes the microphone and returns what was heard.
actions.output: Resolves with { transcript, confidence, durationSeconds, latencyMs, language } — confidence is null for cloud transcripts — or null when nothing was captured or transcription failed. In cloud mode the audio file is kept in lastRecordingUri either way.

actions.name: setRecognitionMode(mode)
actions.desc: Chooses the engine for the next run.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.desc: On-device keeps audio on the phone and streams partials; cloud records first and needs an API key.

actions.output: Returns nothing. model updates to name the engine that will be used.

agentNote: Prefer 'on-device' mode when isOfflineAvailable is true: it keeps audio on the device and streams partials. isOfflineAvailable is not language specific, so handle a start failure. Show streamingPartial so the user knows they are being heard.
